events.title: Events

description.workspace: What happened in the workspace, who was told and on which channel, what was audited and who saw the data.
description.partner: Your customers' events: the situation of all and the data of the companies you manage.

events.empty: Events show here as soon as they happen.
events.dataHidden: The data stays with the customer. Ask for access to see it.

access.title: Access to the data
access.description: Ask the customer for access to this event's data, with the reason and the request reference.
access.granted: Access approved until {date}. Each view is recorded and the customer sees it.
access.waiting: Request sent. Waiting for the customer's decision.
access.request: Ask for access to the data
access.requestHint: The workspace owner or an admin approves. Only you will see it, only this event, for the approved term.
access.referenceError: Enter the request reference (up to 120 characters).
access.requestsDescription: Support asking to see the data of events of this workspace. You approve, deny or revoke whenever you want.

trace.deliveriesHint: Each delivery with its channel and status, the bell included.
trace.noDeliveries: Nobody was told about this event.
trace.noViews: Nobody outside saw this event's data.
trace.handoffsHint: Each subscriber that received the event, with its status.

settings.title: Notifications

description.platform: The default of each notice for the whole platform: channels, who receives, delivery and locks.
description.partner: Adjust your customers' notices within what the platform left open and lock what cannot change.
description.workspace: Adjust this workspace's notices within what was left open.

rulesDescription.platform: What applies when nobody changes anything. Lock a notice so partners and customers cannot change it.
rulesDescription.partner: Applies to all your customers. Notices locked by the platform do not change.
rulesDescription.workspace: Notices locked by the platform or the partner do not change.

settings.rulesHint: WhatsApp only reaches people who added their number and accepted it in My account. Required notices do not turn off.
settings.readOnly: Only the owner and the admins change these rules.

quiet.title: Quiet window
quiet.description: A WhatsApp received in this window is held and leaves when it ends, in the workspace's time zone. Urgent security events go through.

digest.title: Daily digest
digest.description: Notices delivered in a digest leave together at this time, in the workspace's time zone.

settings.scheduleDescription: When WhatsApp waits and when the daily digest leaves.

templates.title: WhatsApp templates
templates.description: The text of each WhatsApp notice, per language. Each edit creates a new version and the history is kept.
templates.noVersions: No version saved at this level.

whatsapp.title: My WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Your number to receive notices by WhatsApp. Without the acceptance, no notice is sent.
whatsapp.consent: I accept receiving platform notices by WhatsApp on this number.
whatsapp.noNumber: Add your WhatsApp to receive here.

errors.consent: Check the acceptance to receive notices by WhatsApp.

messages.accessRequested: Access request sent to the customer.
messages.dataOpened: Data opened. The view was recorded and the customer sees it.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.duration: The term goes from 24 hours to 7 days.
errors.templateSize: The text goes from 1 to 1000 characters.
errors.status: You cannot change the status of this event.

rule.level: This notice is not adjusted at this level.
rule.essential: A required notice does not turn off.
rule.lock: Only the platform and the partner lock notices.
